## `Core/Graphics/Draw/DrawUtils.h`

- `struct LightningStyle` — Small shapes views share, drawn with Painter (canvas coordinates).
- `LightningStyle`: `int segments = 8`

- `LightningStyle`: `Color4 core { 255, 255, 255, 255 }` — Inner line
- `LightningStyle`: `float glowRadius = 0.0f`
- `LightningStyle`: `float glowAlpha = 0.0f`
- `[[nodiscard]] constexpr Float2 RowSlot(Float2 center, int count, int index, float gap)` — Centre of item 'index' in a row of 'count' items 'gap' apart, centred on 'center' (pips, dots, badges).
- `void DrawStar(Painter& paint, Float2 center, float outerRadius, const ShapeStyle& style)` — Five-pointed star around 'center'.
- `void DrawDiamond(Painter& paint, Float2 center, Float2 half, const ShapeStyle& style)` — Rhombus with its corners above, below and beside 'center'; 'half' is half its width and height.
- `void DrawBand(Painter& paint, Float2 center, float inner, float outer, float start, float sweep, const LineStyle& style)` — Thick arc between 'inner' and 'outer' radii from 'start' over 'sweep' radians (clockwise when positive); a full turn draws a ring.
- `void DrawRing(Painter& paint, Float2 center, float inner, float outer, const ShapeStyle& style)` — Ring between 'inner' and 'outer' radii; the stroke width is outer - inner.
- `void DrawRegularPolygon(Painter& paint, Float2 center, int sides, float radius, float radians, const ShapeStyle& style)` — Regular polygon with 'sides' corners on a circle of 'radius'; the first corner points 'radians' clockwise from +x.
- `void DrawRotatedRect(Painter& paint, Float2 center, Float2 half, float radians, const ShapeStyle& style)` — Rectangle turned 'radians' (clockwise on screen) around its centre; 'half' is half its width and height.
- `void DrawLightning(Painter& paint, Float2 from, Float2 to, int seed, Color4 color, float alpha, const LightningStyle& style)` — 'alpha' replaces the colours' alpha (fading the whole bolt).
- `void DrawTabOutline(Painter& paint, const FloatRect& tab, float thickness, Color4 color)` — Tab border: the top and both sides; the bottom stays open where the tab joins its panel.
- `void DrawTabbedPanelOutline(Painter& paint, const FloatRect& panel, const FloatRect& activeTab, float thickness, Color4 color)` — Panel border whose top edge stays open under the active tab.
